text:
While fierce French fury shows itself
united with the trembling barbarian,
while the dreadful Protestant alliance
plans to unsettle our faith and homeland,

Mars arms your right hand, my lord,
upon which Victory waits,
following that trace of valor
which virtue guides toward immortality.

Already I seem to see your glory’s
high radiance shining so brightly
that it will dazzle your father’s might.

My only fear is that so great a tale
will not be set in everlasting song
unless you yourself become your own chronicler.

translation.title: To the Count of Feria
translation.editorial_note: Imported as a translation without separate editorial review.
